metadata.description: Agent-side companion to the next-expo-supabase-agent-harness: subagents, commands, and skills for monorepos shipping a Next.js web app and an Expo mobile app over one shared Supabase backend.

plugins.name: next-expo-supabase-agent-harness
plugins.description: Agent half of the harness: migration/RLS, DAL, and test authors; security, web-security, mobile-security, accessibility, design, architecture, and code-quality reviewers; a citation verifier; slash commands such as /adr, /new-feature, and /verify-citations; the vertical-slice, e2ee-feature, and mobile-UI-design skills.
